messages:
maya: Heads-up — saw a cluster of similar postmortems in Feb	6Mar. Two main themes: KV cache misses increasing tail latency, and sporadic pod OOMs when long sequences get batched together. Starting this thread to record owners, short ETAs, and canary plans so these don't recur.

sam: I can own KV telemetry and alerting. Will add prefix-miss and hit-rate by model + version.

luca: I have a smart-batching patch that limits sequence-length variance in a batch; staging shows ~15% less p95 memory. Need an owner for a controlled canary (10% traffic).

priya: Ops note: several earlier postmortems lacked explicit owners and due dates, which makes follow-up ad hoc. I'll maintain a mini-tracker here and update the postmortem template to force an owner + ETA field.

maya: Quick tracker (copyable):
- A1 | sam | ETA 2024-05-10 | Add KV prefix-miss metric, dashboard, alert
- A2 | luca | ETA 2024-05-03 | Roll smart-batching canary (10% x 48h), gather mem/latency traces
- A3 | priya | ETA 2024-05-17 | Reconcile open PMs, tag recurrence-risk, assign owners
- A4 | ops-bot | ETA 2024-04-30 | Run automated recurrence scan and post top patterns

sam: I'll open a PR for A1 and stub dashboard panels today: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-telemetry

luca: Canary plan: step1 deploy to canary pool with tracing; step2 10% traffic for 48h; step3 rollback triggers: mem p95 reg >2% or error rate >0.5%. Will post config tomorrow.

maya: Also please run a quick tag co-occurrence on recent incidents to verify top clusters (cache-miss, routing mismatch, quant-regression). Ops-bot, can you publish the scan when ready?

ops-bot: monthly recurrence scan complete. Top 3 patterns last 90d: KV cache misses (17%), routing mismatches (12%), quant regressions (8%). CSV: s3://redwood-ops/recurrence-scans/2024-03-scan.csv

priya: I'll push the template change to docs and add recurrence-risk enum (low/med/high) + required owner/ETA fields. That should cut down orphaned follow-ups.

maya: Let's sync next Wed 10:00am PT. Agenda: A1 status, A2 canary results, template update. @sam @luca @priya update this thread with progress and links by EOD Friday.

sam: Will post dashboard link and PR before EOD.

luca: Canary config and initial traces tomorrow morning.

priya: Tracker updated, pinging owners. :white_check_mark: 

maya: Goal: close two items this sprint. If blocked, escalate in #eng-oncall.
